lines.trans: Miss, come over to our table immediately!
Good day, I am listening to you very attentively.
Look at this, what is that?
I see that this is an ordinary hair.
I also see this long hair perfectly well!
Then why are you asking about it?
How did this hair get onto the plate?
Probably it simply fell out of your head.
Such a long hair cannot be mine!
Then probably it fell out of a beard.
I do not have a beard, call the chef!
Fine, I will call the head chef right now.

meanings.note: hair growing on the chin and lower cheeks
the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
present есть; у меня есть = I have

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.
I grew up in a communal flat.
I can see the toy car.

meanings.en: hair, a single strand of hair

examples.trans: There is a hair in the plate.

meanings.note: polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)

examples.text: Я не выходил! Я выпал из окна!
examples.trans: I didn't walk out! I fell out the window!
The first snow fell during the night.

meanings.en: 'голову оторвать' = to tear someone's head off
meanings.note: an idiom for a big telling-off

examples.trans: Mum will tear my head off.

examples.text: Девушки, как я, у тебя не будет!
examples.trans: You'll never have a girl like me!

meanings.note: на днях = in the next few days, or the other day

examples.trans: I'll call in the next few days.

meanings.note: in greetings: добрый день, добрый вечер
+ genitive: 'из мэрии' = from the town hall

examples.trans: There's someone here to see you.

meanings.note: как вы знаете = as you know

examples.trans: The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.
Well, probably somewhere in the archive.
He has probably already come home.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates
+ prepositional; об before a vowel: об этом

examples.text: Да нет на него никакого компромата. Обычный мужик.
examples.trans: There is no compromising material on him at all. Just an ordinary guy.

meanings.en: other forms: его (gen/acc), ему (dat), им (instr), нём (prep)

examples.trans: I know this town really well!
I love our town very much.

meanings.en: to come up to, to approach

examples.text: Дядя Аркадий всё починит и позовёт.
examples.trans: Uncle Arkady will fix everything and call you.

meanings.en: to get to, to end up
meanings.note: как попасть в центр? = how do I get to the centre?

examples.trans: A firework hit the power station.
How do I get to the station?

meanings.en: to have a look, to take a look

meanings.note: the imperative 'слушай' starts a sentence, like 'look, ...'

examples.trans: We will sit together in a friendly way at the table.

examples.text: У нас есть большая тарелка рыбы и крабов.
examples.trans: We have a big platter of fish and crabs.
Put clean plates on the table.

meanings.en: executive chef, head of a kitchen

examples.trans: The head chef developed a new menu.
She works as an executive chef in Moscow.

meanings.note: points at something: это моё = that's mine

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом

examples.trans: I'm sick of this communal flat.
